rationale: Jacob and Rafael are both building in embodied AI and robotics from first-principles infrastructure up—Jacob from the full-stack AI systems and perception side at VibeStartup, Rafael from the autonomous systems and vision-language-action product angle at ProdLab after leading Zoox. Rafael's deep experience shipping robotics at scale (Zoox, Wavyn) pairs well with Jacob's expertise in evolutionary algorithms, on-device AI, and resilient perception systems, making them natural collaborators on the infrastructure and product challenges of physical intelligence.
intro_message: Jacob Valdez, meet Rafael Marañón — you're both SF-based founders solving complementary pieces of embodied AI (full-stack infrastructure + robotics perception vs. autonomous systems + vision-language-action), and both surfaced each other as strong matches.
